message.content: {"caption":"A three-stage illustration compares learning approaches as human supervision decreases, from a person-guided robot to robots acting without a visible human.","description":"A conceptual diagram has three sections, separated by vertical dashed lines and labeled “Supervised Learning,” “Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards,” and “Absolute Zero (Ours).” In the first section, a person stands to the left of a running brown robot and holds a small dark controller; a thought bubble above the person contains a red flag. A red flag on a pole stands to the robot’s right. In the middle section, a person points toward a running orange robot; a thought bubble above the person contains a red flag, and another red flag on a pole stands to the robot’s right. In the final section, two orange robots appear without a person: a smaller upright robot stands beside a larger running robot. A thought bubble above them contains a red flag, and a red flag on a pole stands to the right. The flags depict a goal or task marker. Along the bottom, a large gray arrow points right and is labeled “Less Human Supervision,” indicating decreasing human involvement across the three sections.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
